steps.action: Precondition: signed in, location selected, cart non-empty. Click 'Proceed to checkout'
GET /api/checkout, POST /api/checkout/validate, GET /api/fulfillment/options; defaults: Ship to Home, default address, billing same, default saved card
Choose delivery method (Ship to Home / Store Pickup -> choose pickup store; Local Delivery disabled outside Houston Metro)
Choose/add shipping address (Add address form validates required fields client-side)
Billing same as shipping or choose billing address
Choose saved card or 'Use a new card' and fill card details
Review Order summary (subtotal, fulfillment cost, estimated tax, total, date). STOP — 'Place order' not clicked.

evidence.observation: All steps traversed in session except Place order; observed totals and section changes as described in CheckoutPage
